name: pixels
desc_en: From the dark of the camera the photograph is read off the sensor: square photosites fourteen across under a faint red, green and blue filter, halving on each even beat of a motor drive until the sharp picture snaps into place.
desc_zh: 從相機的黑暗中，照片從感光元件上被讀出來：一排十四格的方形感光點，蓋著淡淡的紅綠藍濾色，隨著連拍馬達均勻的節拍一再對半細分，直到清晰的照片咔一聲定住。
borrowed: A stepped, not eased, reveal: a handful of hard cuts on an even beat, each the photograph at a higher resolution, so the picture is present from the first frame as its own colour and arrives as detail.
